body: From the DM-184 review (orchestrator, this run): resubmitting a report needs explicit restatement — an experiment not restated by `id` plus `{ reportId, assessmentId }` is withdrawn, and resubmitting the same body by subject mints new ids and strands the originals' events. The corrective/authoring flow must restate experiments correctly; DM-192 should document it for orchestrators.
